phase: ROADMAP Stage 3: deterministic approved-facts paragraph audit v1
baseline: Release repo main 4ae1ba1 Add structured writing plan. Claude Code had already produced a related WSL diff for approved evidence flags; Codex reviewed it and adjusted the data model to also support payload facts and approved_facts as requested.
summary: Added an additive approved_facts_audit surface to analyze_payload. It checks each draft paragraph's required claim markers against request-local pre-approved fact sources: payload facts, structured approved_facts, and explicitly approved evidence. Existing status, score, issues, structured_writing_plan, and writing_state behavior is unchanged.
implemented: backend/server.py: added _truthy_approval(raw) for approved/review_approved/is_approved evidence flags.

backend/server.py: added _approved_fact_search_items(payload), adapting payload['facts'], payload['approved_facts'], and explicitly approved payload evidence into stable local search-like items without mutating the payload.
backend/server.py: added build_approved_facts_audit(payload, analysis), returning method=approved_facts_audit_v1, source_counts, approval_provided, approved_fact_count, paragraphs, and summary.
Per-paragraph audit entries include index, text, required_markers, used_fact_markers, unapproved_markers, approved_fact_ids, status, and warnings.

Paragraph status is no_claim_markers when no required markers exist, all_facts_approved when every required marker is covered by approved fact sources, and uses_unapproved_facts when any marker is absent.
tools/run_quality_gates.py py-compile gate now includes tests/test_approved_facts_audit.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary: deterministic lexical audit only, no DB query, no model call, no NLI/semantic entailment.
not_implemented: No semantic entailment, NLI, legal correctness, or claim truth judgment beyond lexical marker coverage.
No library database retrieval; only request-local payload fields are used.
No LLM calls, DOCX formatting, targeted paragraph rewrite, locked paragraph diff, or rollback implementation.
No frontend rendering for approved_facts_audit in this slice.
test_status: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 182 tests OK.
python tools/validate_retrieval_suite.py --suite tests/data/retrieval_eval_suite.json --json: passed=true, with expected placeholder/<50-case warnings.
risks: approved_facts_audit is deterministic linkage metadata only; all_facts_approved must not be treated as semantic support, legal/policy correctness, or final review.
payload['facts'] is treated as user-confirmed approved fact text by contract. Callers needing stricter approval provenance should use approved_facts or approved evidence flags.
Coverage is exact lexical marker coverage through existing helpers, so paraphrased approved facts may be conservatively flagged.
The audit is nested in analyze_payload output; frontend rendering and top-level /api/generate surfacing are intentionally left for a later UI/API slice.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified.
No external network calls were used for implementation or tests.
